一只小猪十只狼

杨永青

上海市浦东新区川沙镇人，擅长版画、中国画、图书插画，早年
师从著名人物画家谢闲鸥先生，1952年—1987年历任华东青年出版社、中国青年出版社、中国少年儿童出版社美术编辑、编审。创作儿童图书220余册以及数千幅插画，20余种儿童画册以多国文字在海外

出版发行。曾获全国少年儿童图书评奖美术一等奖、中国版画家协会
“鲁迅奖章”、国际安徒生奖提名等诸多荣誉。获国务院妇女儿童协调委员会颁发的“有突出贡献的儿童工作者”和关心下一代工作委员会颁发的“先进个人”等称号。作品被中国美术馆等多家机构收藏。曾任文化部儿童文学艺术委员会委员、中国美术家协会儿童美术艺术委员会主任、中国版画家协会第一届理事以及其他社会兼职十余项。

page_text_en:
One Pig, Ten Wolves

Yang Yongqing

Born in Chuansha Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, he is skilled in woodcut, Chinese painting, and book illustration. He studied under the renowned portrait painter Mr. Xie Xianou in his early years. From 1952 to 1987, he served as an art editor and reviewer at the East China Youth Publishing House, China Youth Publishing House, and China Children's Publishing House. He created over 220 children's books and thousands of illustrations, with more than 20 children's art albums published overseas in multiple languages.

He has received numerous honors, including the First Prize for Art in the National Children's Book Awards, the "Lu Xun Medal" from the China Printmakers Association, and a nomination for the Hans Christian Andersen Award. He was awarded the title of "Outstanding Children's Worker" by the State Council's Women and Children's Coordination Committee and "Advanced Individual" by the Working Committee for Caring for the Next Generation. His works are collected by institutions such as the National Art Museum of China. He has served as a member of the Children's Literature and Art Committee of the Ministry of Culture, Chairman of the Children's Art Committee of the China Artists Association, a founding council member of the China Printmakers Association, and held over ten other social positions.

在一片茂密的大森林里，有座木房子。里面住着一只小猪。他自己照顾自己，过得很舒服。从早到晚，他总喜欢唱一首歌：“大森林，小木屋，舒舒服服小胖猪！”

page_text_en:
One Little Pig, Ten Wolves

In a dense forest, there was a wooden house. Inside lived a little pig. He took care of himself and lived very comfortably. From morning till night, he always liked to sing a song: "Big forest, little wooden house, cozy little fat pig!"

One particularly cold day, the little pig was making a fire to cook inside. He planned to cook himself a pot of delicious vegetable porridge, then take a nice hot bath, and sleep a deep, snoring sleep. Just as he was boiling water, a knocking sound came from outside: "Bang bang bang!" The little pig curiously asked, "Who is it?"

One Little Pig, Ten Wolves
summary_zh: 本页介绍了故事背景：在茂密的森林里，一只小猪独自住在木屋里，生活舒适。一天，他正在生火做饭，准备享受温暖的晚餐和热水澡时，突然听到门外传来敲门声，小猪好奇地询问来者是谁。

page_text_ocr_zh:
门外传来一阵沙哑的声音：“是我啊，亲爱的小猪，寒冷的北风吹得我好难受，让我进去暖和暖和吧！”小猪听出来了，这是森林老狼的声音。
“请你到别处去吧！”小猪回答。老狼可怜巴巴地说：“亲爱的小猪，我冷得受不了了，请你救救我。只要让我伸进去一条腿，我就不会冻死了。”
page_text_en:
A hoarse voice came from outside the door: "It's me, dear little pig. The cold north wind is making me so uncomfortable. Let me come in and warm up!" The little pig recognized the voice—it was the old wolf from the forest.
"Please go somewhere else!" the little pig replied. The old wolf said pitifully, "Dear little pig, I can't stand the cold anymore. Please save me. Just let me stick in one leg, and I won't freeze to death."
summary_zh: 森林老狼在门外假装冻得难受，请求小猪让他进屋取暖，小猪识破其伪装并拒绝了他。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小猪想了想，说：“好吧，不过你只能伸进来一条腿！”
老狼把一条腿伸了进来。没过十秒，他又恳求道：“亲爱的小猪，让我把另一条腿也伸进去吧！我还是很冷！”小猪想了想，说：“好吧，就让你伸进另一条腿！”
page_text_en:
The little pig thought for a moment and said, "Alright, but you can only stick in one leg!"
The old wolf stuck one leg in. Less than ten seconds later, he pleaded, "Dear little pig, let me stick in the other leg too! I'm still so cold!" The little pig thought for a moment and said, "Alright, I'll let you stick in the other leg!"
summary_zh: 小猪同意让老狼先伸一条腿进屋取暖，老狼随后又请求伸进另一条腿，小猪再次同意。

page_text_ocr_zh:
可是，一、二、三……没过七秒，老狼又说：“亲爱的小猪，我的胳臂快冻坏了，让我把胳臂也放进去吧！”聪明的小猪想了想，转转眼珠回答：“好吧，你等一下。”
小猪找来一个口袋，先把老狼的腿塞进口袋里，然后说：“好了，你退着进屋吧！”，
page_text_en:
But, one, two, three... within seven seconds, the old wolf said, "Dear little pig, my arms are freezing! Let me put my arms in too!" The clever little pig thought for a moment, rolled his eyes, and replied, "Alright, wait a minute." 
The little pig found a bag, put the wolf's legs into it, and then said, "Alright, go in backwards!"
summary_zh: 老狼请求将手臂也放进屋内取暖，小猪同意后，找来口袋将狼的腿塞进去，并让他退着进屋。

page_text_ocr_zh:
老狼心里正窃喜，没想到钻进了口袋。小猪赶紧用绳子把口袋结结实实地扎了起来。
接着，他搬来一坛热水，哗地浇在了老狼的身上。“啊！烫死啦！”老狼大声嚎叫。
page_text_en:
The old wolf was secretly delighted, not realizing he had crawled into the bag. The little pig quickly tied the bag tightly with a rope.
Then, he brought a jar of hot water and poured it over the old wolf. "Ah! I'm being scalded!" the old wolf screamed loudly.
summary_zh: 小猪将老狼装进口袋并扎紧，随后用一坛热水浇在老狼身上，老狼被烫得大声嚎叫。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小猪放下水坛，打开屋门，给扎紧的口袋松绑，然后爬上了屋顶，藏在烟囱后面。老狼挣扎了一会儿，从口袋里爬出来，逃进了大森林。
没过十分钟，老狼带着九只狼恶狠狠地冲出大森林，径直奔向小猪家。“小猪，你给我出来！看我们不吃了你！”老狼大叫道。
page_text_en:
The little pig put down the water jar, opened the door, untied the tightly bound sack, climbed onto the roof, and hid behind the chimney. The old wolf struggled for a while, crawled out of the sack, and escaped into the big forest.
Less than ten minutes later, the old wolf, leading nine other wolves, fiercely charged out of the big forest and headed straight for the pig's house. "Little pig, come out! We'll eat you!" the old wolf shouted.
summary_zh: 小猪将老狼装入袋中并松绑后藏于屋顶烟囱后，老狼逃脱后带着九只狼前来报复，威胁要吃掉小猪。

page_text_ocr_zh:
十只狼在小猪家翻箱倒柜，把小猪做好的一锅菜粥也打翻在地。
“胖小猪，你在哪里？”老狼生气地叫着。
“老大，他在屋顶上！”一只狼在院子里高兴地指着小猪说。
page_text_en:
Ten wolves ransacked the piglet's house, knocking over the pot of stew he had just made.
"Fat piglet, where are you?" the big wolf shouted angrily.
"Boss, he's on the roof!" one wolf happily pointed at the piglet in the yard.
summary_zh: 十只狼闯入小猪家中翻箱倒柜，打翻了小猪的菜粥，并在院子里发现小猪躲在屋顶烟囱后，一只狼兴奋地向老大报告了小猪的位置。

page_text_ocr_zh:
没有梯子，十只狼上不了房，他们围坐在一起想办法。“哈哈，有啦！我们叠罗汉爬上去！”老狼说道。“妙计！太妙了！”九只狼称赞道。
老狼趴在最下面，第二只狼踩在他的腰上，第三只狼踩在第二只狼的肩上，第四只狼踩在第三只狼的肩上……就这样，第十只狼终于够着了屋顶。
page_text_en:
Without a ladder, the ten wolves couldn't get onto the roof, so they sat together to think of a plan. "Ha ha, I've got it! Let's climb up like a human pyramid!" said the old wolf. "Brilliant! Absolutely brilliant!" the nine wolves exclaimed.
The old wolf lay at the bottom, the second wolf stepped on his waist, the third wolf stepped on the second wolf's shoulders, the fourth wolf stepped on the third wolf's shoulders... and so on, until the tenth wolf finally reached the roof.
summary_zh: 十只狼因没有梯子无法上房，便决定叠罗汉攀爬屋顶，最终第十只狼成功够到屋顶。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“快抓住他！”老狼在最下面喊。小猪突然喊道：“大家快动手，用开水浇这群坏蛋！”老狼被烫过，知道热水的厉害，吓得撒腿就跑。上面的狼们没注意，都摔了下来。
最上面的狼当场就摔死了，其余几只狼也摔了个半死，伤得不轻。它们只好拄着树棍一瘸一拐地回到森林了。
page_text_en:
"Quick, catch him!" the old wolf shouted from the bottom. The little pig suddenly shouted: "Everyone, hurry up and pour boiling water on these rascals!" The old wolf, having been scalded before, knew the danger of hot water and ran away in fear. The wolves above didn't notice and all fell down.
The wolf on top died instantly, and the rest were knocked half to death, badly injured. They could only limp back to the forest, leaning on sticks.
summary_zh: 小猪趁狼群叠罗汉攀爬屋顶时，命令大家用开水浇狼，导致最上面的狼摔死，其余狼受伤后一瘸一拐地逃回森林。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小猪从房顶下来，把屋子打扫干净，然后又熬了一锅美味的菜粥。
他吃饱了饭，拿着扫把打扫院子里的雪，边扫边唱：“大森林，
小木屋，开开心心小胖猪。”
page_text_en:
The little pig came down from the roof, cleaned the house, and then cooked a pot of delicious vegetable porridge.
He ate his fill, took a broom to sweep the snow in the yard, and sang as he swept: "Big forest, little wooden house, happy little pig."
summary_zh: 小猪从屋顶下来打扫屋子并熬制菜粥，随后在院子里扫雪，边扫边唱着快乐的歌谣。
